title: Survey on Simple Knowledge Graph Question Answering
summary: This community centers on a 2021 survey paper titled 'Challenges, Techniques, and Trends of Simple Knowledge Graph Question Answering: A Survey.' The work was authored by Mohammad Yani and Adila Alfa Krisnadhi and published in the journal Inf. It serves as a foundational reference for understanding the landscape of question answering systems built upon simple knowledge graphs.
key_findings: The survey paper was published in 2021 in the journal Inf., specifically in volume 12, issue 7, as article number 271.
Mohammad Yani and Adila Alfa Krisnadhi are identified as the co-authors of this specific survey.
The paper focuses specifically on 'Simple' Knowledge Graph Question Answering, distinguishing it from more complex multi-hop or general QA tasks.
The survey is cited in the context of other knowledge graph and QA research, such as QA-GNN and HotpotQA, indicating its relevance to the broader field of graph-based reasoning.
